name: Illicit Tobacco and Excise Evasion
description: Smuggling, counterfeit and illegal manufacture of tobacco and other excise goods to avoid duty, including diversion from duty suspension, undeclared transit and sale through informal retail. Cash proceeds are layered via small shops, wholesalers and cross-border transfers.

sources.text: WHO FCTC, Protocol to Eliminate Illicit Trade in Tobacco Products (2012)
OECD and EUIPO, public material on illicit trade
World Customs Organization, public material on tobacco smuggling

exposure.rationale: Cash-heavy retailers and wholesalers, cash deposits and supplier remittances.

indicators.name: Wholesaler purchases far exceed local market demand
indicators.canon: Wholesaler purchases far exceed local market demand
indicators.desc: Volumes of cigarettes or alcohol bought by a retailer or distributor exceed plausible consumption.
indicators.ctx: Volumes of cigarettes or alcohol bought by a retailer or distributor exceed plausible consumption.
indicators.fp: Border areas and tourism cause higher sales.

indicators.name: Goods in transit declared to low-tax or non-EU destinations but not arriving
indicators.canon: Goods in transit declared to low-tax or non-EU destinations but not arriving
indicators.desc: Duty-suspended shipments disappear or end up in domestic markets.
indicators.ctx: Duty-suspended shipments disappear or end up in domestic markets.

indicators.name: Cash-heavy small shops with large tobacco turnover and little card use
indicators.desc: Customer's business relies heavily on cash receipts, making revenue difficult to verify against stock, costs or card use.
indicators.ctx: Convenience stores with cash deposits not matching stock purchases.

indicators.name: Payments to or from free-trade zones and tax-free ports
indicators.canon: Payments to or from free-trade zones and tax-free ports
indicators.desc: Transfers linked to zones known for tobacco diversion.
indicators.ctx: Transfers linked to zones known for tobacco diversion.

indicators.name: Counterfeit or unbranded cigarettes sold with 'cheap' pricing
indicators.canon: Branded or duty-paid goods priced far below genuine market levels
indicators.desc: Prices are implausibly low for authentic or duty-paid products, suggesting counterfeit or illicit supply.
indicators.fp: Promotions exist but not below duty.

indicators.name: Illegal factory equipment or leaf purchases
indicators.canon: Illegal factory equipment or leaf purchases
indicators.desc: Orders for tobacco-making machinery, paper, filters.
indicators.ctx: Orders for tobacco-making machinery, paper, filters.

indicators.name: Cross-border cash and remittance flows from retailers to overseas suppliers
indicators.canon: Cross-border cash and remittance flows from retailers to overseas suppliers
indicators.desc: Regular remittances to suppliers in source countries without invoices.
indicators.ctx: Regular remittances to suppliers in source countries without invoices.

indicators.name: Vehicle or container rental by small firms for bulk transport
indicators.canon: Vehicle or container rental by small firms for bulk transport
indicators.desc: Frequent rental or purchase of vans and containers.
indicators.ctx: Frequent rental or purchase of vans and containers.
